section.catchline: Statement of commission transmitted to county auditors -- Contents of statement -- Duties of auditors -- Change of assessment prohibited.
section.subsection:
The commission shall, before June 8, annually transmit to the county auditor of each county to which an apportionment has been made a statement showing:
the property assessed; the value of the property, as fixed and apportioned to the tax areas; and the aggregate amount of taxable value placed in dispute in accordance with Section 59-2-1007.

The county auditor shall enter the:
statement on the county assessment roll or book; and amount of the assessment apportioned to the county in the column of the assessment book or roll which shows for the county the total taxable value of all property.
A county board of equalization may not change any assessment fixed by the commission.
